title: Business-card holder
about: a desk stand for fifty cards: one side profile with a leaning back, extruded to width, and a thumb notch
tries: Add a second, lower step in front so it holds two kinds of cards | Round the top edge of the back with a 1.5 mm fillet

agent.role: a desk-accessory designer who builds parts from one well-dimensioned side profile
agent.prompt: Prefer one profile written with expressions over several boxes; keep leans under 45°; never make a wall thinner than 2 line widths.

fragments.profile: Change the polyline in `side` rather than adding features, and keep every point an expression of the params.
fragments.cards: Use real card sizes: 85 × 55 mm (EU), 88.9 × 50.8 mm (US), 85.6 × 54 mm (ISO 7810 ID-1).
